scientific_integrity: Global optimality follows from the written symbolic proof. The finite rational tests are not an infinite certificate. General graph FMMC and homogeneous Hamming results are prior work. Publication-priority uncertainty remains and independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Covers symmetric nonnegative stochastic kernels with single-coordinate edges and arbitrary holding on mixed-alphabet complete-graph Cartesian products; no finite-time total-variation optimum, nonreversible optimum, nonuniform target, or uniqueness outside coordinate-permutation-invariant kernels is claimed.
title: Fastest symmetric mixing on heterogeneous Hamming products
